posts.title: MTG: Reality Fracture
posts.description: This is my set recap for the Reality Fracture MTG set! Limited Summary / Notes I played a lot of Reality Fracture, a total of 35 events, the most I've played for a set since Final Fantasy last year. (Though I did also play 35 events during SOS season, except a good chunk of them were EOE events.) This set was very good to me, especially in Quick Draft and my one Premier Draft, with both formats giving me above-average win rates. However, my overall win rate was dragged down because I decided to try getting into Traditional Draft for the first time. (See below.) Even with TD dragging me down, the overall win rate still came in slightly above my running average! Without Trad Draft, my win rate would come in at a bit above 60%, which would have been my second-best win rate historically after Wilds of Eldraine . posts.title: A Postcard
posts.description: I've never received a postcard. 1 It's not really a thing people do over here. So when I saw this service that sends you out a free sample postcard, I thought "OK neat, I'll try that". They promised not to sell my data and it looks nothing like a big corporate thing. They apparently sell subscriptions with these postcards. Anyway, I signed up, and a guy emailed me to confirm the details and he sent it out to me last month. The postcard arrived this morning all the way from Denver, Colorado, a little bit worse for the wear: TBH, I did not have a lot of faith in our local postal system so I would not have been surprised if it did not arrive at all. But it did! It was a pleasant surprise. Based on the stamped dates, I would guess it arrived at our local post office exactly a month after it was sent, and got to our house a few days later. posts.title: Weeknotes 2026-11-22
posts.description: The World After last week's big tech outages, I think there were a few smaller ones earlier this week - I remember a short ICloud outage and something affecting US banks. There were also a number of new vulns/CVEs reported. I had to patch/update my server again, but it was much easier this time since I knew what I was doing (thanks Server Patching Notes !) Cybersecurity peeps are so tired of this probably. We had three extra days of holidays this week due to the ASEAN Summit. It happened on the far side of the Metro so we weren't really affected (but it was nice because there was less traffic). DJT was here for a little bit before flying off to an APEC summit in China to meet with his dictator buddies Putin and Xi. Big news in the gaming world was the release of the highly anticipated GTA6, which made something close to FOUR BILLION DOLLARS almost immediately. Most of my gamer groups are pretty non-mainstream so I didn't really know anyone personally who was playing it. My Week Google
